trend.title: Bhopal Hosts India's Main Fable 5.1 Buildathon Amid Bangalore Buzz
trend.title_original: Claude Fable 5.1 Build Days Launch Worldwide with Bhopal Spotlight
trend.summary_by_grok: Claude's Fable 5.1 Build Days launched this week with global events, including a full-day session in Bhopal on September 20 organized by local ambassador Aniket Sahu. The event offers hands-on model intros, build challenges in tracks like Delight and Breakthrough, $100 API credits per attendee, and final project demos. Bangalore users joked about being overlooked—'blr mfs gonna start crying'—but a separate Build Day is set there on September 25, and organizers noted the Bhopal pick stems from its active community ambassador. These gatherings let developers test Fable 5.1's coding strengths by building real solutions.
trend.summary_original: The Claude community kicked off Fable 5.1 Build Days, a worldwide buildathon from September 11 to 25, inviting people to experiment with Anthropic's new model for coding and complex tasks in cities like Cape Town, Nairobi, Stockholm, Singapore, Tokyo, and Bhopal. Bhopal's selection drew light-hearted reactions, with users joking about Bengaluru folks' surprise while others celebrated the city's rising profile and even quipped about poha stocks soaring. In Bhopal, the sold-out Claude Code Impact Lab focuses on prototyping AI ideas to improve the city, with similar hands-on events planned elsewhere via the Claude Community calendar on Luma.
